text: What's happened to them? That's easy, Mr. Carey. They're half human, half Cyberman.
That was quick. Yes, I believe that doorway is a time portal, a time portal under cyber control.
You belong to us. Like...
Administrator, Dr. Savage's transponder is back online. She's okay.
What are these transponders? Micro receivers implanted into the skin of our arms. It means we can track our people.
Have you all got one? All central personnel have one, ma'am. Standard.
Except me. Why on earth not?
Oh, God. Don't tell me you're one of those my-body-is-my-temple types.
Actually, Administrator, I'm allergic. My skin reacts badly to implants.
Hey, Evelyn, we can be a unique team on our own. Covert undercover missions where Central can't find us.
Yes, thank you. Now, what about the Doctor's party? One can assume they're safe.
We shouldn't assume they're safe at all until we speak to them.
Excuse me? I'm in command here, Dr. Smythe. It might have been a communications party.
If everything is online again and there's no sign of the temporal wave...
Not due for about 45 minutes, sir.
Then I think we should stay calm.
Oh, I can tell you're new at this. Look, my time with the Doctor has shown me that...
Dr. Smythe! If you would prefer to wait in the Doctor's TARDIS, then it is only a few feet away.
Feel free to remain there until I decide what to do next.
Well, I've all...
Come on, Dr. Smythe. Evelyn, I'm sure the Doc will be just fine and...
Get away from here!
What the hell?
Administrator! Cybermen! Behind us!
Well, Administrator, we found the secret on this planet for you.
Doctor, what's going on?
No time, Evelyn. Isherwood, you must contact your mothership. Get away from here!
I'm gonna stay here, try and close off that portal thing before any more Cybermen emerge and...
You are my prisoners. Do not move.
Good God. That's Nicola Savage. What's happened to her? And those other two?
A few months of cyber grafts in about 30 seconds.
Is that possible?
If that portal thing is a time gate, yes. It may operate in a different time zone.
She might have been in there for minutes, or years.
And is it? A time gate, I mean?
Looks like it. Those three partial Cybermen came through it.
This planet is under cyber control.
Boss?
Leave her, Mr. Wrenchard. Despite the human bits on display, mentally she's a thrall to cyber commands.
Dr. Savage is gone. They all are.
And in their place is a... of those?
Yes. I'm sorry.
But, Doctor, why only half a Cyberman?
I mean, normally they're completely encased in the cyber suits.
Good question. I hardly think Cybermen have gained an aesthetic sense, so there has to be a practical reason.
What if...
Which of you is the Doctor?
Lots of Doctors and Professors here...
You will be silent. I require the Doctor. The Doctor who operates that craft there.
He can recognize the TARDIS, but not you.
It also has exceptional hearing, Evelyn, so shush.
You are the Doctor.
Sorry.
I am.
You are required by the Controller.
Oh yes, and where is he then?
Through the portal.
Oh, I see. Obvious, really.
So why isn't he here himself?
Good question. Do you have a good answer?
Explain.
Well, if the Cyber Controller sent you and your two chums over there to get me, why not come himself?
Perhaps he's feeling under the weather.
Evelyn, you may have hit the nail on the head.
So, why do you need the TARDIS?
You already have a time portal.
That information is unimportant to you.
I think it's extremely important to me, actually. It's my TARDIS.
Maybe if you gave it to them, Doctor, they'd go away.
Oh, come on, Administrator. That's just dumb.
Administrator, take a look at the two Cybermen that arrived with Savage here. Anyone you know?
My God. That's Ricky Allen. Professor Kuzmakis' assistant.
I think I recognize the other one as...
Lawrence, the military commander of Osborn's group.
Interesting. Don't you think?
The Doctor is as cautious as our records warned us.
Commander, is your subcutaneous transponder still operational?
Yes, Controller. It has been reconfigured as a mental transmitter and receiver. The humans cannot hear our conversations.
Excellent. Separate the humans and have the Doctor brought here.
Yes, Controller.
Why do they want the TARDIS?
Perhaps they can't operate their time gate properly, but know that the TARDIS can go anywhere. When piloted properly, anyway.
Cybermen with time travel. That's a new and horrible thought.
Indeed.
Doctor, the Controller requires your presence.
Why?
You will come with us. Take the others away.
Yes, Commander.
I say again, why?
You will come with us.
Why? Tell me why I should.
Careful, Doctor.
If you do not, the hostages will be killed.
So? Well, that's hardly a threat if I refuse to budge a handful of lives gone. If I go with you and give you the secrets of my TARDIS, that's eternity gone. Not really a contest, is it?
Thanks. He has a point.
Doctor, these four humans are your friends.
Their deaths can be slow and painful.
So that's it. Come with us or we hurt your friends.
No. My friends mean a great deal to me, but they're still expendable when put against the fate of the universe.
You won't get what you want by killing anyone.
You have three minutes to decide.
Will you really sacrifice us, Doctor?
If he has to, yes.
Evelyn, you know me too well.
There's something else wrong here.
Something savage just said.
It doesn't make sense.
We'll stay here as hostages until further notice.
Cheers. Thanks.
Great. So the Doctor's willing to sacrifice us just to make a point.
To be fair, Administrator, he has a good point.
I don't want to die any more than you, but it's the five of us against the galaxy.
Well, we knew the risks when we signed on, sir.
Look, this Doctor won't give them the TARDIS, and thus we get to die.
But if we gave them the TARDIS,
and offered to help sort out their time portal with its machinery or whatever's inside,
then that would give the Doctor time to come up with another plan that doesn't cost us our lives.
Besides which, our job was to learn about this portal.
Its temporal technology may be worth billions.
I'm not sure, Administrator.
Why would the Cyberman thing, you know, that looks like Doctor Savage, fall for it?
Yeah, and what about the temporal wave? What's it? It's due shortly.
Oh, come on.
Let's give our cyber chum here a message for...
Oh. He's gone.
I'm not sure, Doctor.
I feel I want to be doing something rather than sitting around here awaiting execution.
Well, I'm not sure I want you to be executed, Evelyn, thank you very much.
At the moment, playing for time is all we can do.
We don't have much time, though. That temporal wave thing is due shortly.
I think I can guess what it's for now.
Go on.
Well, I think the description of it as a wave is pretty accurate.
It operates like a trawler net flowing out from the portal
and then receding back again, but dragging everything with it.
It took both previous teams through,
and the Cybercontrollers turned them into his rather bizarre-looking Cybertroops.
Cybercontroller's gone to a lot of effort to set it up.
Him? Well, no. No, he didn't do this.
That temple, or whatever it is, and the portal
are the product of a far better civilization that's long since gone.
Or gone through the portal.
Which would explain the lack of other exits.
No, I think he's using second-hand equipment.
It's all a bit haphazard, though. What if no one had been here?
He has the equipment, but has lost the instruction manual.
And as he's in a different time zone from us,
he might have been sitting there watching the temple wave scoop nothing up for eons.
Very patient, Cybercontrollers.
I see.
And this one is like a cybernetic prester John,
sitting at the end of time with his holy grail,
waiting for someone to show him how to use it.
You? Me. But you can't.
Oh, don't worry, Mr. Goddard.
I may have to help him translate the instruction manual.
But I can easily lose the last page.
Yes, the hostages.
I am aware of their conversation.
All members of the human party have subcutaneous transponders.
I have adjusted mine to act as a receiver.
Everything the humans say I can now overhear.
The human issuant plots to betray us.
He is unaware that we already know this.
It is worthwhile to pretend.
To accept his terms.
Either way, we shall take the Doctor's TARDIS through the portal.
Why do we not just take it now?
Why do we need the Doctor?
The Controller knows that access to the TARDIS equipment is only obtainable via the Doctor.
And his brain will be adapted to our purposes.
The Controller wants the Doctor to succeed him as the next Controller.
With his knowledge of time and space mechanics,
The Controller's plan will be fulfilled.
